Follow a neighbor through the ramen-shop door and look for her at the counter. Another bends toward the flowers for a quiet sniff before continuing along the street.

Opening the street.

About this preview

Two neighbors take short shop visits among six passersby. The ramen customer touches the sliding-door handle, enters, lingers behind the counter window, and returns to the street. The flower visitor bends to smell the blossoms. This is a motion and interaction study with the same resident artwork; purchases, meals, a varied cast, and real weather are later work.
